title: Advanced Boids Flocking in 3D Aquarium
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an advanced 3D boids flocking simulation inside a glass aquarium using Three.js. Requirements:

## Scene Setup
- Perspective camera at position (0, 5, 20), looking at origin
- Ambient light (0.4 intensity) + two directional lights from opposite corners
- A transparent glass aquarium box: 20x12x16 units (width x height x depth), centered at origin, rendered with MeshPhysicalMaterial (transmission=0.9, roughness=0.1, transparent, opacity=0.15)
- Aquarium floor with subtle sand-colored plane and small decorative rocks (simple sphere geometries)
- Background color: dark blue gradient (0x001122)

## Boids System
- Start with 40 boids, each represented as a cone geometry (radius=0.15, height=0.5) colored with a hue based on their flock group
- 3 flock groups: Red (group 0), Green (group 1), Blue (group 2). Initial distribution: 15 red, 15 green, 10 blue
- Each boid has: position (Vec3), velocity (Vec3), acceleration (Vec3), group (int), energy (float 0-100, starts at 100)
- Implement Craig Reynolds flocking rules with these weights:
  - Separation: 2.5 (avoid crowding neighbors within radius 1.5)
  - Alignment: 1.0 (steer towards average heading of neighbors within radius 3.0)
  - Cohesion: 1.2 (steer towards average position of neighbors within radius 3.5)
  - Same-group affinity bonus: multiply cohesion by 1.8 for same-group neighbors
- Max speed: 4.0 units/sec, max force: 0.3
- Boids lose 0.05 energy per second. When energy < 10, speed is halved. When energy reaches 0, boid becomes inactive (stops moving, turns gray)
- Boundary avoidance: boids steer away from aquarium walls when within 2.0 units of any wall with force proportional to proximity

## Food System
- Food pellets are small yellow spheres (radius=0.1) that spawn at random positions inside the aquarium
- When a boid comes within 0.8 units of food, it consumes it (food disappears, boid gains 25 energy, capped at 100)
- Food spawns every 3 seconds automatically (max 10 food items at once)

## Scoring System
- Score starts at 0
- +5 points when user manually drops food (click interaction)
- +1 point per food consumed by any boid
- -2 points when a boid becomes inactive (energy=0)
- Flock cohesion bonus: every 10 seconds, if average distance between same-group boids < 4.0, award +10 points per qualifying group

## User Interactions
- Left-click on aquarium: drop food pellet at the clicked 3D position (raycast onto a horizontal plane at y=0)
- Keyboard 'P': toggle pause/resume simulation
- Keyboard 'R': reset entire simulation to initial state (40 boids, score=0, clear food)
- Keyboard 'F': toggle fast-forward mode (2x simulation speed)
- Keyboard '1','2','3': highlight boids of that group (add emissive glow), press again to unhighlight
- Keyboard 'S': spawn 5 additional boids (random group) up to max 60 total
- DOM button 'Add Food Burst': spawn 5 food pellets at random positions simultaneously

## HUD/UI
- Top-left: Score display, Boid count (active/total), Food count
- Top-right: Simulation speed indicator ('1x' or '2x'), Pause indicator
- Bottom: Button 'Add Food Burst'
- All text white on semi-transparent dark background

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- boidCount: total number of boids
- activeBoidCount: boids with energy > 0
- foodCount: current food pellets in scene
- score: current score (integer)
- paused: boolean
- simSpeed: 1 or 2
- totalFoodConsumed: cumulative count
- groupCounts: [redCount, greenCount, blueCount] of active boids
- highlightedGroup: -1 (none) or 0,1,2
- avgGroupSeparation: [avgDistRed, avgDistGreen, avgDistBlue] (average intra-group distance)
- totalEnergy: sum of all boid energies
- frameCount: number of simulation frames elapsed
- lastFoodDropPosition: {x,y,z} of last user-dropped food or null
- inactiveBoidCount: boids with energy === 0
- maxSpeedObserved: highest speed any boid has reached this session

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame. Use requestAnimationFrame for the render loop with delta-time based updates.
physics_constraints: Boids must obey max speed (4.0 units/sec at 1x, 8.0 at 2x). All boid positions must remain within aquarium bounds (-10 to 10 x, -6 to 6 y, -8 to 8 z). Energy is clamped [0, 100]. Total energy must decrease monotonically unless food is consumed. Conservation: total food consumed + current food count + expired food = total food ever spawned. No NaN in any position or velocity.
